title: Serialize Roblox values for saving
prompt:
Write a ModuleScript that returns a table with two functions. `encode(value)` turns a value that may contain
Vector3, CFrame (with rotation), Color3, numbers, strings, booleans and nested tables (arrays and dictionaries with
string keys) into plain tables, numbers, strings and booleans only, so it survives JSON. `decode(encoded)` turns the
result back into the original values and types. The runner sends the encoded value through JSONEncode/JSONDecode
between the two calls.
